{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Found {len(qa_rows)} QA rows with revenue = 999999.99.")

# Check if any of them are completed or refunded
print(qa_rows['status'].value_counts())

# Now, parse revenue as float after removing commas
# First, inspect a few values to confirm the format
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the transformation
print(df[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head())

# Check for any remaining -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")"}
